launch.busy: Request in progress. Actions are unavailable until its outcome is known; do not repeat an uncertain write.
launch.current: Current gate read — re-read before acting
launch.empty: No operating duties returned. This is not proof of coverage.
launch.idRequired: Enter the exact record ID before this action is available.
launch.idScope: The record must belong to the selected estate. Server-side authority and revision checks still apply.
launch.meanings: Reported completion is a declaration. Historical verification records a past observation. Current proof requires fresh evidence and current authority.
launch.partial: Partial operating evidence — unresolved duties remain.
launch.receipt: Reported write receipt — not current proof
launch.unavailable: Operating records unavailable — not an empty estate.

resilience.airgapHelp: to block all external feeds; offline CVE/registry updates arrive as signed bundles.
resilience.airgapHint: Set AIRGAP_MODE=true and AIRGAP_ALLOWLIST to block all external feeds; offline CVE/registry updates arrive as signed bundles.
resilience.backupHelp: Uses the configured pg_dump backend, encrypts the captured archive and retains its signed manifest. Failed attempts are listed below. These actions do not run retention/purge or prove a restore; PostgreSQL PITR requires a separate physical backup and WAL archive workflow.
resilience.backupScheduledHint: Runs due backups via the injected dump runner (pg_dump / neo4j-admin in production), encrypts (Fernet), signs a manifest, persists artifacts, then applies GFS retention/purge.
resilience.backupScheduledTitle: Scheduled encrypted backups (Postgres + Neo4j) with retention
resilience.buildBundleHint: Run on an internet-connected host to package CVE/registry advisories into a signed, hash-verified bundle, then carry it to the air-gapped network and import it below.
resilience.bundleHelp: Run on an internet-connected host to package CVE/registry advisories into a signed, hash-verified bundle, then carry it to the air-gapped network and import it below.
resilience.databaseRequired: enter an approved PostgreSQL database name first
resilience.evidenceHelp: Production refuses manual positive assertions. Use retained, independently reviewable evidence for compliance decisions.
resilience.evidenceLabel: Operator-supplied evidence by tag (JSON; not independently verified)
resilience.noCleartext: no cleartext engineering detected in this frame.
resilience.noRetainedBackups: no retained backups exist to evaluate
resilience.otHint: Passive decode of observed spans (S7comm/102, EtherNet-IP/44818, BACnet/47808, OPC-UA/4840).
resilience.otNoCleartext: No cleartext engineering detected in this frame.
resilience.otPcapLabel: Upload a passive capture (.pcap) — parsed offline, never probed
resilience.pcapLabel: Upload a passive capture (.pcap) — parsed offline, never probed
resilience.persistedSuffix: database schedule(s); worker execution not verified here
resilience.previewOnly: Preview only — no backup is deleted.
resilience.restoreNotAvailable: Restore is not available from this console: it changes a database and requires a separately approved, isolated recovery target and a verified bank runbook. A created logical backup is not a PITR drill.
resilience.subtitle: signed reports · encrypted logical backups · hash-chain attestation · air-gap feeds · passive OT decode

securityControls.chainNoProblems: Every retained snapshot links to the one before it.
securityControls.exportCaveat: Both carry evidence ids and the observation class per control. CONFIGURED is not OBSERVED, and OBSERVED is not RUNTIME_OBSERVED.
securityControls.exportHelp: The same estate model, in the formats the bank already ingests. Neither export invents a verdict: a refusal exports as a refusal.
securityControls.findingsHelp: Findings are relationships the collector could evidence. A control with no finding was read and had nothing to report; a control that refused appears under "refused", never here as an all-clear.
securityControls.neverRead: No control has been read yet
securityControls.neverReadHelp: An empty table here is not a clean estate: it means no collector has produced a snapshot. Every control below still shows the state that explains why.
securityControls.noFindings: This snapshot produced no findings. That is not the same as a clean estate: check the controls tab for what was never read.
securityControls.notIntegrated: Not integrated (a gap in this layer, not a finding)
securityControls.nothingRefused: No control refused a read in the last snapshot.
securityControls.positioning: CryptoScan integrates with the bank's existing network and security controls to build an evidence-backed cryptographic and security estate model.
securityControls.refusedHelp: What this device refused to tell us, and why. A refusal is a fact about the integration or the device, not about the control's effectiveness.
securityControls.stateUnknown: a state this build does not recognise
securityControls.title: Security control estate
